long_biography.plain_text:
Andrew Forrest founded Fortescue in 2003 with the aim of creating a third major force in Western Australian iron ore. He grew the exploration venture into a large mining and infrastructure group and remains its executive chairman. His substantial Fortescue shareholding, rather than ownership of individual mines or railways, remains the principal foundation of his fortune.

Fortescue's success later provided capital for Tattarang, a private investment group with interests across renewable energy, resources, agriculture, health technology, consumer brands and property. Forrest's present business portfolio is therefore broader than mining, but Fortescue remains its dominant identifiable economic anchor. His upbringing at Minderoo Station gave him longstanding familiarity with the Pilbara, but he built rather than inherited Fortescue and its core stake.

uncertainties.detail: The current business identity is Andrew Forrest or Dr Andrew Forrest AO. The fuller birth-name form is John Andrew Henry Forrest. Because the source record correctly uses Andrew as the preferred first name, no middle-name proposal is made that would incorrectly render the display name as Andrew John Henry Forrest.

Forrest founded rather than inherited Fortescue, so Self-made is strongly supported. His family's longstanding Minderoo Station and Pilbara background may have supplied familiarity or social capital, but reviewed sources do not establish a material family contribution to Fortescue's launch. Independent start is therefore not asserted, while advantaged start remains a below-threshold candidate.

Tattarang is materially diversified, including energy, resources, agriculture, health technology, consumer brands and property. Metals & Mining remains the current primary industry because the Fortescue stake is independently described as the largest component of the family fortune.

Fortescue's mines, processing facilities, railways, ports, production, revenue and project values belong to the listed company. Forrest's economic interest principally arises through shares and distributions; the dossier does not attribute the underlying operations to him personally. Tattarang portfolio companies and Minderoo Foundation assets are likewise kept at entity level.

The Australian National University supports the 1961 birth year and Perth birthplace. The exact 18 November date is consistently published in the established biographical record and aligns with Forbes' current age, but it is retained at high rather than very-high confidence.

No exact personal LinkedIn, Instagram or personal website was verified. Search results for those names resolved to unrelated namesakes. The existing Wikipedia URL contains embedded spaces and should be normalized separately if the update workflow supports social corrections.

Politics, public advocacy, controversies, allegations, legal matters, disputes, private-family trivia and vessel research were excluded. Philanthropic entities are mentioned only where necessary to explain the later investment structure and are not treated as personal assets.
